description.en: A self-hosted DSH plugin index for dsh-storage-inspector.
description.zh: dsh-storage-inspector 的自托管 DSH 插件索引。

description.en: Shows where the DSH directory spends disk space, module by module, with dual physical/logical units, largest files, and three-tier cleanup advice that explains what is safe, careful, or forbidden. Read-only and fully local.
description.zh: 按模块显示 DSH 目录的磁盘占用，给出物理/逻辑双口径、最大文件与三层清理建议（可删 / 谨慎 / 禁止）并说明原因。只读、纯本地、不联网。
